name: plasma-graphics-tools
description: KDE Plasma / SDDM session helpers and black-screen fix tools.

package:
install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-plasma-session << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Configure SDDM (or plasmalogin) and Plasma sessions for X11 or Wayland.

set -euo pipefail

REPORT="/var/log/aryalinux-plasma-session.log"

log() { printf '%s\n' "$*" | tee -a "$REPORT"; }

need_root() {
    if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "This script must be run as root." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
}

active_display_manager() {
    for dm in sddm plasmalogin lightdm gdm; do
        if systemctl is-enabled "$dm" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "$dm"
            return
        fi
    done
    if [ -L /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service ]; then
        basename "$(readlink -f /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service)" .service
        return
    fi
    echo "unknown"
}

configure_paths() {
    local dm="$1"

    case "$dm" in
        sddm)
            CONF_DIR="/etc/sddm.conf.d"
            MAIN_CONF="/etc/sddm.conf"
            ;;
        plasmalogin)
            CONF_DIR="/etc/plasmalogin.conf.d"
            MAIN_CONF="/etc/plasmalogin.conf"
            ;;
        *)
            CONF_DIR="/etc/sddm.conf.d"
            MAIN_CONF="/etc/sddm.conf"
            ;;
    esac
    DROPIN="${CONF_DIR}/aryalinux-session.conf"
}

detect_gpu_vendor() {
    if command -v lspci >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        if lspci -nn | grep -Eiq 'vga|3d|display'; then
            lspci -nn | grep -Ei 'vga|3d|display' | head -3
            return
        fi
    fi
    echo "unknown"
}

list_sessions() {
    echo "Available X11 sessions (/usr/share/xsessions):"
    if [ -d /usr/share/xsessions ]; then
        ls -1 /usr/share/xsessions/*.desktop 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -n1 basename || echo "  (none)"
    else
        echo "  (directory missing)"
    fi
    echo
    echo "Available Wayland sessions (/usr/share/wayland-sessions):"
    if [ -d /usr/share/wayland-sessions ]; then
        ls -1 /usr/share/wayland-sessions/*.desktop 2>/dev/null | xargs -r -n1 basename || echo "  (none)"
    else
        echo "  (directory missing)"
    fi
}

current_display_server() {
    local dm="$1"
    configure_paths "$dm"

    if [ -f "$DROPIN" ] && grep -q '^DisplayServer=' "$DROPIN"; then
        sed -n 's/^DisplayServer=//p' "$DROPIN" | head -1
        return
    fi
    if [ -f "$MAIN_CONF" ] && grep -q '^DisplayServer=' "$MAIN_CONF"; then
        sed -n 's/^DisplayServer=//p' "$MAIN_CONF" | head -1
        return
    fi
    case "$dm" in
        sddm) echo "unset (SDDM default is usually x11)" ;;
        plasmalogin) echo "unset (plasmalogin default is usually wayland)" ;;
        *) echo "unset" ;;
    esac
}

write_dropin() {
    local dm="$1"
    local server="$2"
    local session="${3:-}"

    configure_paths "$dm"
    need_root
    install -d -m 755 "$CONF_DIR"
    {
        echo "# Written by aryalinux-plasma-session on $(date -Iseconds)"
        echo "[General]"
        echo "DisplayServer=${server}"
        if [ -n "$session" ]; then
            echo "Session=${session}"
        fi
    } > "$DROPIN"
    chmod 644 "$DROPIN"
    log "Wrote ${DROPIN} with DisplayServer=${server}${session:+, Session=${session}}"
}

write_autologin() {
    local dm="$1"
    local user="$2"
    local session="${3:-plasmax11.desktop}"

    configure_paths "$dm"
    need_root
    install -d -m 755 "$CONF_DIR"
    {
        echo "# Written by aryalinux-plasma-session on $(date -Iseconds)"
        echo "[General]"
        echo "DisplayServer=x11"
        echo "Session=${session}"
        echo
        echo "[Autologin]"
        echo "User=${user}"
        echo "Session=${session}"
    } > "$DROPIN"
    chmod 644 "$DROPIN"
    log "Wrote autologin for ${user} (${session}) to ${DROPIN}"
}

display_manager_note() {
    local dm="$1"

    case "$dm" in
        sddm)
            echo
            echo "SDDM uses an X11 login greeter by default. Pick \"Plasma (X11)\" or"
            echo "\"Plasma (Wayland)\" from the session menu on the login screen."
            ;;
        plasmalogin)
            if [ -x /usr/bin/startplasma-login-wayland ] && [ ! -x /usr/bin/startplasma-login-x11 ]; then
                echo
                echo "plasmalogin only ships a Wayland login greeter. DisplayServer=x11 affects"
                echo "sessions after login, not the greeter screen. If you see a black screen"
                echo "with a mouse cursor, use: sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin USER"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
}

restart_display_manager() {
    local dm="$1"

    need_root
    if [ "$dm" != "unknown" ] && systemctl is-enabled "$dm" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "Restarting ${dm}..."
        systemctl restart "$dm"
        return
    fi
    log "No enabled display manager found; reboot to apply changes."
}

recommend_server() {
    if lspci -nn 2>/dev/null | grep -Eiq 'nvidia'; then
        echo "x11"
        return
    fi
    if [ -d /sys/module/nouveau ]; then
        echo "x11"
        return
    fi
    echo "wayland"
}

strip_autologin() {
    local dm="$1"

    configure_paths "$dm"
    [ -f "$DROPIN" ] || return 0
    awk '
        /^\[Autologin\]/ { skip=1; next }
        skip && /^\[/ { skip=0 }
        !skip { print }
    ' "$DROPIN" > "${DROPIN}.tmp" && mv "${DROPIN}.tmp" "$DROPIN"
}

usage() {
    cat <<'EOF'
Usage: aryalinux-plasma-session [command]

Commands:
  status          Show display manager, display server, GPU, and sessions
  recommend       Print recommended display server for this hardware
  x11             Prefer X11 (SDDM greeter + Plasma X11 sessions)
  wayland         Prefer Wayland greeter/sessions
  autologin USER [SESSION]  Boot into Plasma without the login greeter
  clear-autologin Remove [Autologin] from the AryaLinux drop-in
  interactive     Guided setup (default)
  help            Show this help

Examples:
  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session x11
  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session autologin aryalinux plasmax11.desktop
  sudo aryalinux-plasma-session status
EOF
}

interactive() {
    local dm gpu rec current choice session

    dm="$(active_display_manager)"
    configure_paths "$dm"
    log "=== aryalinux-plasma-session interactive setup ==="
    gpu="$(detect_gpu_vendor)"
    rec="$(recommend_server)"
    current="$(current_display_server "$dm")"

    echo "Display manager: $dm"
    echo "Detected GPU:"
    echo "$gpu"
    echo
    echo "Current DisplayServer: $current"
    echo "Recommended for this system: $rec"
    echo
    list_sessions
    echo

    if [ "$rec" = "x11" ]; then
        echo "NVIDIA/nouveau systems often show a black screen on Wayland until"
        echo "proprietary drivers or nouveau firmware are fully working."
        echo "X11 is the safer first choice."
        echo
    fi

    printf 'Choose display server [x11/wayland] (default %s): ' "$rec"
    read -r choice
    choice="${choice:-$rec}"
    case "$choice" in
        x11|wayland) ;;
        *)
            echo "Invalid choice: $choice" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac

    printf 'Optional default session .desktop name (Enter to skip): '
    read -r session

    write_dropin "$dm" "$choice" "$session"
    restart_display_manager "$dm"
    display_manager_note "$dm"
    echo
    echo "Also run: sudo aryalinux-graphics-setup apply"
}

cmd="${1:-interactive}"
DM="$(active_display_manager)"
configure_paths "$DM"

case "$cmd" in
    status)
        echo "Display manager: $DM"
        echo "GPU:"
        detect_gpu_vendor
        echo
        echo "DisplayServer: $(current_display_server "$DM")"
        echo "Drop-in: $DROPIN"
        [ -f "$DROPIN" ] && cat "$DROPIN" || echo "(not configured)"
        echo
        list_sessions
        ;;
    recommend)
        recommend_server
        ;;
    x11)
        write_dropin "$DM" x11
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        display_manager_note "$DM"
        ;;
    wayland)
        write_dropin "$DM" wayland
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        ;;
    autologin)
        need_root
        [ -n "${2:-}" ] || { echo "Usage: aryalinux-plasma-session autologin USER [SESSION]" >&2; exit 1; }
        write_autologin "$DM" "$2" "${3:-plasmax11.desktop}"
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        echo "Reboot to land in Plasma without the login greeter."
        ;;
    clear-autologin)
        need_root
        strip_autologin "$DM"
        echo "Removed [Autologin] from $DROPIN"
        restart_display_manager "$DM"
        ;;
    interactive)
        interactive
        ;;
    help|-h|--help)
        usage
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown command: $cmd" >&2
        usage >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-plasma-session

install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-kde-login-diagnose << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# KDE / Plasma login diagnostic — writes /var/log/aryalinux-kde-login-diagnose.txt
# Run on the live AryaLinux system:  su -c aryalinux-kde-login-diagnose

set -u

REPORT=/var/log/aryalinux-kde-login-diagnose.txt
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$REPORT")"
: >"$REPORT"

section() {
    {
        echo
        echo "======== $1 ========"
    } >>"$REPORT"
}

run() {
    {
        echo "\$ $*"
        "$@" 2>&1 || echo "(exit $?)"
    } >>"$REPORT"
}

have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

section "When / who"
run date -Iseconds
run uname -a
run cat /etc/os-release

section "Boot targets"
run systemctl get-default
run readlink -f /etc/systemd/system/display-manager.service

section "Display managers (enabled / active)"
for dm in sddm lightdm plasmalogin gdm; do
    run systemctl is-enabled "$dm"
    run systemctl is-active "$dm"
done

section "Display manager status (full)"
for dm in sddm lightdm plasmalogin gdm; do
    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$dm" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "--- systemctl status $dm ---" >>"$REPORT"
        systemctl status "$dm" --no-pager -l >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
    fi
done

section "Multiple DM warning"
enabled=""
for dm in sddm lightdm plasmalogin gdm; do
    if systemctl is-enabled "$dm" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        enabled="$enabled $dm"
    fi
done
echo "enabled display managers:$enabled" >>"$REPORT"
case "$enabled" in
    *" "*) echo "WARNING: more than one display manager is enabled — pick one." >>"$REPORT" ;;
esac

section "Plasma sessions"
run ls -la /usr/share/xsessions/
run ls -la /usr/share/wayland-sessions/
for bin in startplasma-x11 startplasma-wayland plasmashell; do
    if [ -x "/usr/bin/$bin" ]; then
        echo "found: /usr/bin/$bin" >>"$REPORT"
    else
        echo "missing: /usr/bin/$bin" >>"$REPORT"
    fi
done

section "SDDM config"
run cat /etc/sddm.conf
for f in /etc/sddm.conf.d/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "--- $f ---" >>"$REPORT"
    cat "$f" >>"$REPORT" 2>&1
done

section "LightDM config"
run cat /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf 2>/dev/null
for f in /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf.d/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "--- $f ---" >>"$REPORT"
    cat "$f" >>"$REPORT" 2>&1
done
run ls -la /etc/lightdm/ 2>/dev/null

section "plasmalogin config"
run cat /etc/plasmalogin.conf 2>/dev/null
for f in /etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "--- $f ---" >>"$REPORT"
    cat "$f" >>"$REPORT" 2>&1
done

section "GPU / drivers"
if have lspci; then
    lspci -nnk | grep -A3 -Ei 'vga|3d|display' >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
else
    echo "lspci not installed" >>"$REPORT"
fi
for mod in nouveau nvidia amdgpu i915; do
    [ -d "/sys/module/$mod" ] && echo "module loaded: $mod" >>"$REPORT"
done
run nvidia-smi 2>/dev/null
run ls -la /dev/dri/ 2>/dev/null
run ls -la /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/ga106/ 2>/dev/null

section "PAM"
for f in sddm sddm-greeter lightdm lightdm-gtk-greeter system-auth system-session kde; do
    [ -f "/etc/pam.d/$f" ] && echo "present: /etc/pam.d/$f" >>"$REPORT" \
        || echo "missing: /etc/pam.d/$f" >>"$REPORT"
done

section "Qt6 (SDDM / greeters)"
run ls -la /opt/qt6/plugins/platforms/libqxcb.so 2>/dev/null
if have ldconfig; then
    ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -i qt6 | head -20 >>"$REPORT" || true
    ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -i xcb-cursor >>"$REPORT" || echo "missing: libxcb-cursor (Qt 6.5+ needs this for xcb)" >>"$REPORT"
fi
for f in /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env/qt6.sh /etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-kde.conf; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "--- $f ---" >>"$REPORT"
    cat "$f" >>"$REPORT"
done

section "Plasma / KWin journal (this boot)"
if have journalctl; then
    journalctl -b --no-pager -n 80 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'plasmashell|kwin|qt\.qpa|xcb-cursor|ABRT|segfault' >>"$REPORT" || true
fi

section "X11 sockets"
run ls -ld /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix 2>/dev/null

section "Journal logs"
if have journalctl; then
    run journalctl -u sddm -b --no-pager -n 120
    run journalctl -u lightdm -b --no-pager -n 120
    run journalctl -u plasmalogin -b --no-pager -n 80
    run journalctl -u display-manager -b --no-pager -n 40
fi

section "Xorg logs"
for f in /var/log/Xorg.0.log /var/log/Xorg.1.log; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "=== $f (errors) ===" >>"$REPORT"
    grep -Ei 'EE|WW|fatal|nouveau|nvidia|glx|dri|modeset|No screens' "$f" | tail -60 >>"$REPORT" 2>&1 || true
done
for home in /home/*; do
    [ -d "$home" ] || continue
    for f in "$home/.local/share/xorg/Xorg.0.log" "$home/.xsession-errors"; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        echo "=== $f ===" >>"$REPORT"
        tail -80 "$f" >>"$REPORT" 2>&1
    done
done
for f in /var/lib/sddm/.local/share/xorg/Xorg.0.log /var/log/lightdm/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "=== $f ===" >>"$REPORT"
    tail -80 "$f" >>"$REPORT" 2>&1
done

section "Prior AryaLinux helper logs"
for f in /var/log/aryalinux-graphics-diagnose.log /var/log/aryalinux-plasma-session.log; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    echo "=== $f ===" >>"$REPORT"
    cat "$f" >>"$REPORT"
done

section "Done"
echo "Report: $REPORT" >>"$REPORT"
echo "Wrote $REPORT"

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-kde-login-diagnose

install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-kde-login-fix << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Fix KDE/SDDM black screen (nouveau, missing Qt6 session env, Wayland session).
# Live system:  su -c aryalinux-kde-login-fix
# Then reboot.

set -euo pipefail

LOG=/var/log/aryalinux-kde-login-fix.log
MARKER="# aryalinux-kde-login-fix"

need_root() {
    [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || {
        echo "Run as root: su -c aryalinux-kde-login-fix" >&2
        exit 1
    }
}

log() {
    printf '%s\n' "$*" | tee -a "$LOG"
}

desktop_user() {
    local u
    if [ -n "${ARYALINUX_USER:-}" ] && id "$ARYALINUX_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "$ARYALINUX_USER"
        return
    fi
    if id aryalinux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo aryalinux
        return
    fi
    while IFS=: read -r u _ uid _ _ _ _; do
        [ "$uid" -ge 1000 ] 2>/dev/null || continue
        [ -d "/home/$u" ] || continue
        echo "$u"
        return
    done </etc/passwd
    echo ""
}

write_sddm_dropin() {
    install -d /etc/sddm.conf.d
    cat > /etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-kde.conf << EOF
$MARKER $(date -Iseconds)
[General]
DisplayServer=x11
GreeterEnvironment=QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb,QT_PLUGIN_PATH=/opt/qt6/plugins,QML2_IMPORT_PATH=/opt/qt6/qml

[Theme]
Current=breeze

[Users]
DefaultPath=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/opt/qt6/bin
Session=plasmax11.desktop

[X11]
SessionCommand=/usr/share/sddm/scripts/Xsession
EOF
    chmod 644 /etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-kde.conf
    log "Wrote /etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-kde.conf (X11 + breeze + Qt6 greeter)"
}

write_plasma_qt6_env() {
    install -d /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env
    cat > /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env/qt6.sh << 'EOF'
# aryalinux-kde-login-fix — Qt6 paths for Plasma X11 sessions
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb
export QT_PLUGIN_PATH=/opt/qt6/plugins
export QML2_IMPORT_PATH=/opt/qt6/qml
export PATH="/opt/qt6/bin:${PATH}"
EOF
    chmod 755 /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env/qt6.sh

    install -d /etc/profile.d
    cat > /etc/profile.d/aryalinux-plasma-qt6.sh << 'EOF'
# aryalinux-kde-login-fix — login shells and SDDM sessions
export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb
export QT_PLUGIN_PATH=/opt/qt6/plugins
export QML2_IMPORT_PATH=/opt/qt6/qml
pathappend /opt/qt6/bin PATH
EOF
    chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/aryalinux-plasma-qt6.sh
    log "Wrote Plasma/Qt6 session environment snippets"
}

disable_kwin_compositing() {
    local user="$1"
    local home kwinrc
    [ -n "$user" ] || return 0
    home="$(getent passwd "$user" | cut -d: -f6)"
    [ -n "$home" ] && [ -d "$home" ] || return 0
    kwinrc="$home/.config/kwinrc"
    install -d -o "$user" -g "$user" "$home/.config"
    if [ -f "$kwinrc" ] && grep -q '^\[Compositing\]' "$kwinrc"; then
        if grep -q '^Enabled=' "$kwinrc"; then
            sed -i '/^\[Compositing\]/,/^\[/ s/^Enabled=.*/Enabled=false/' "$kwinrc"
        else
            sed -i '/^\[Compositing\]/a Enabled=false' "$kwinrc"
        fi
    else
        cat >>"$kwinrc" << 'EOF'

[Compositing]
Enabled=false
EOF
    fi
    chown "$user:$user" "$kwinrc"
    log "Disabled KWin compositing for $user (~/.config/kwinrc)"
}

remove_stale_plasmalogin() {
    rm -f /etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/aryalinux-session.conf
    log "Removed stale /etc/plasmalogin.conf.d/aryalinux-session.conf (SDDM ignores it)"
}

check_libxcb_cursor() {
    if ldconfig -p 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'libxcb-cursor'; then
        log "OK: libxcb-cursor is installed"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ -f /usr/lib/libxcb-cursor.so.0 ] || [ -f /usr/lib64/libxcb-cursor.so.0 ]; then
        log "OK: libxcb-cursor library file present"
        return 0
    fi
    log "WARNING: libxcb-cursor missing — install xcb-util-cursor (or xcb-utilities) and rebuild qt6"
    return 1
}

cmd_apply() {
    local user

    need_root
    : >"$LOG"
    log "=== aryalinux-kde-login-fix $(date -Iseconds) ==="
    user="$(desktop_user)"
    [ -n "$user" ] && log "Desktop user: $user" || log "WARNING: no desktop user found"

    remove_stale_plasmalogin
    write_sddm_dropin
    write_plasma_qt6_env
    [ -n "$user" ] && disable_kwin_compositing "$user"

    if command -v aryalinux-graphics-setup >/dev/null; then
        log "Running aryalinux-graphics-setup apply..."
        aryalinux-graphics-setup apply >>"$LOG" 2>&1 || true
    else
        log "aryalinux-graphics-setup not installed — skipped"
    fi

    command -v ldconfig >/dev/null && ldconfig || true
    check_libxcb_cursor || true

    echo
    echo "Done. Log: $LOG"
    echo
    echo "Reboot now, then log in and pick Plasma (X11)."
    echo "Do NOT run plasmashell as root — use: su -c aryalinux-plasma-restart"
    echo "If still black after reboot: su -c aryalinux-kde-login-diagnose"
}

cmd_status() {
    echo "SDDM drop-in:"
    [ -f /etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-kde.conf ] && cat /etc/sddm.conf.d/aryalinux-kde.conf || echo "(missing)"
    echo
    echo "Plasma Qt6 env:"
    [ -f /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env/qt6.sh ] && cat /etc/xdg/plasma-workspace/env/qt6.sh || echo "(missing)"
    echo
    check_libxcb_cursor || true
}

usage() {
    cat <<'EOF'
Usage: aryalinux-kde-login-fix [command]

Commands:
  apply     Apply KDE/SDDM black-screen fixes (default)
  status    Show current AryaLinux KDE fix configuration
  help      Show this help

Live system:
  su -c aryalinux-kde-login-fix
  reboot
EOF
}

case "${1:-apply}" in
    apply) cmd_apply ;;
    status) cmd_status ;;
    help|-h|--help) usage ;;
    *)
        echo "Unknown command: $1" >&2
        usage >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

ARYALINUX_EOF
chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-kde-login-fix

install -d $DESTDIR/usr/bin
cat > $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-plasma-restart << 'ARYALINUX_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Restart Plasma shell/compositor for the desktop user from a text console.
# Live system (TTY):  su -c aryalinux-plasma-restart
# Never run plasmashell as root — it will crash (ABRT).

set -euo pipefail

need_root() {
    [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || {
        echo "Run as root: su -c aryalinux-plasma-restart" >&2
        exit 1
    }
}

desktop_user() {
    local u
    if [ -n "${ARYALINUX_USER:-}" ] && id "$ARYALINUX_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "$ARYALINUX_USER"
        return
    fi
    if id aryalinux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo aryalinux
        return
    fi
    if command -v loginctl >/dev/null; then
        u="$(loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '$3 ~ /^[a-z]/ {print $3; exit}')"
        [ -n "$u" ] && echo "$u" && return
    fi
    while IFS=: read -r u _ uid _ _ _ _; do
        [ "$uid" -ge 1000 ] 2>/dev/null || continue
        [ -d "/home/$u" ] || continue
        echo "$u"
        return
    done </etc/passwd
}

find_display() {
    local d
    for d in :0 :1; do
        [ -S "/tmp/.X11-unix/X${d#:}" ] && echo "$d" && return
    done
    echo ":0"
}

run_as_user() {
    local user="$1"
    shift
    if command -v runuser >/dev/null; then
        runuser -u "$user" -- "$@"
    else
        su - "$user" -c "$(printf '%q ' "$@")"
    fi
}

main() {
    local user home display

    need_root
    user="$(desktop_user)"
    [ -n "$user" ] || {
        echo "No desktop user found. Set ARYALINUX_USER=yourname" >&2
        exit 1
    }
    home="$(getent passwd "$user" | cut -d: -f6)"
    display="$(find_display)"

    echo "Restarting Plasma for user=$user DISPLAY=$display"
    echo "(Do not run plasmashell as root.)"

    export QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb
    export QT_PLUGIN_PATH=/opt/qt6/plugins
    export QML2_IMPORT_PATH=/opt/qt6/qml

    run_as_user "$user" env \
        DISPLAY="$display" \
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u "$user")" \
        QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb \
        QT_PLUGIN_PATH=/opt/qt6/plugins \
        QML2_IMPORT_PATH=/opt/qt6/qml \
        PATH="/opt/qt6/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" \
        dbus-run-session -- kwin_x11 --replace &

    sleep 2

    run_as_user "$user" env \
        DISPLAY="$display" \
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u "$user")" \
        QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb \
        QT_PLUGIN_PATH=/opt/qt6/plugins \
        QML2_IMPORT_PATH=/opt/qt6/qml \
        PATH="/opt/qt6/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" \
        plasmashell --replace &

    echo "Started kwin_x11 and plasmashell. Switch back to the graphical VT (often Ctrl+Alt+F1)."
}

main "$@"

chmod 755 $DESTDIR/usr/bin/aryalinux-plasma-restart

# Plasma graphics tools

KDE Plasma / SDDM session helpers. For GPU-agnostic X11 setup see `graphics-session-tools`.

## Install onto a live system (from build host)

With the AryaLinux root mounted at `/mnt/lfs`:

```bash
graphics/plasma-graphics-tools/install-kde-tools /mnt/lfs
```

## On the live AryaLinux system

```bash
su -c aryalinux-kde-login-fix
reboot
```

If you still get a black desktop after login (from a text console, Ctrl+Alt+F3):

```bash
su -c aryalinux-plasma-restart
```

**Do not run `plasmashell` as root** — it will crash with ABRT. The restart tool runs it as your desktop user.

| Command | Purpose |

| `aryalinux-kde-login-fix` | SDDM breeze theme, Qt6 paths, Plasma X11, disable KWin compositing |

| `aryalinux-plasma-session` | SDDM X11/Wayland drop-in, autologin |
| `aryalinux-graphics-setup` | X11 sockets + nouveau-safe Xorg (from graphics-session-tools) |
| `aryalinux-graphics-diagnose` | General graphics report |

## Related ports

- `graphics-session-tools` — `aryalinux-graphics-setup`, `aryalinux-graphics-diagnose`
- `sddm` — default KDE display manager
- `xcb-util-cursor` — required by Qt 6.5+ for the xcb platform plugin (via `xcb-utilities`)
